description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for an OpenCart admin extension report called 'Product Purchased'. It manages rendering report pages, saving report settings, and generating product purchase data with filtering and pagination.

classes.name: ProductPurchased
classes.description: Controller class for managing the 'Product Purchased' report in OpenCart's admin area. Handles rendering report pages, saving configurations, and fetching report data with filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language files, sets page title, prepares breadcrumbs, loads layout components, and outputs the report form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report settings via POST, including permission check, updating settings, and returning JSON status.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the product purchased report with data fetched via getReport(), includes order status filtering.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the report list view directly by calling getReport().

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates the report data with optional filters for date range and order status, handles pagination, and returns a rendered view as string.
